scope: Shared classic ESP32 SoC GPIO model; the hosted catalog does not contain ESP32-DevKitM-1 as a board profile.

gaps.detail: No power net drives the MCU; the hosted run assumes an ideal 3.3 V rail, so power-on and brown-out reset are not simulated.

scope_note: This hosted check verifies the shared ESP32 GPIO behavior, not the new DevKitM-1 bridge or local board descriptor. The repository-local onboarding smoke runs the exact board system profile.
